description: Anthem Cat: syncopated Super Saw anthem hook over Am F C G at 138 BPM, octave doubled, building in dynamics.
Hands Up Lead: bouncy bright octave riff over Am F C G at 138 BPM.
Rolling Saw Bass: rolling 16th bass off the kick, one octave higher than before.
Slow wide pad over Am F C G chords.
Trance Pluck: Super Saw pluck arpeggio, longer decay and a wider filter opening (demo settings, the factory preset is unchanged).
Uplift Stab: fast syncopated chord stabs at 138 BPM, rising in energy.
